_note: WHO YOU ARE — the single source of truth for your company identity.
Anything in this file can be reused anywhere else on the site by writing
{{brand.whatever}} inside any piece of text. Change it here once and it
updates on every page automatically.
Example: {{brand.email}} is used by the footer, the contact page, the
booking confirmation and the privacy policy. Edit the email below and all
four change together.
name: Wrath Labs

_note: The logo writes the name in two halves — the first is bright white, the
second is dimmed. Keep these two matching the name above.
The big headline on the home page, split across two lines. The second
line is the one painted in the orange/red gradient.

description: {{brand.name}} helps founders turn ideas into something real they can test in weeks, then builds the full product with precision and quality. We also build our own startups.

_note: Short phrases that appear in several different sentences across the site.
Written lower-case so they can sit in the middle of a sentence.
Image files live in the `public` folder. A path of /brand/og.png means
the file public/brand/og.png. Drop a new file in with the same name to
swap the picture without touching anything here.
The social preview is the picture people see when your link is shared on
X, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Slack. It should be 1200x630 pixels.
The browser tab icon is the little square on the tab, and the home screen
icon is what appears if somebody saves the site to their phone.

logo._note: Screen-reader description of the logo in the top-left corner.
